decisions.reason: As a multi-variant organic line presented as the flagship of the firm's announced organic expansion, dropping it would write off a visible, central commitment, so management will persist and attribute any weak results to the early market phase.

It fits the organic direction and has its own web page, but as a single, low-investment snack item it would be easier to drop. Its proximity to the core business and short time on the market favour keeping it for now.

It is a multi-variant line with a dedicated web presence, close to the firm's core salami competence. The visible investment and the short time on the market make continuation more likely than a write-off.
